name: Agent Sandbox strict egress policy
description: When agentSandboxEgressMode is strict, SandboxTemplate must carry an explicit managed NetworkPolicy with no egress rules. The ordinary managed default still allows public internet and does not satisfy this control.
remediation: Keep networkPolicyManagement Managed and explicitly set spec.networkPolicy.egress to an empty list. This mode does not permit any egress destinations.
test: Enforces explicit default-deny egress only when strict mode is selected in control configuration.
